title: Does Machine Translation Retain Media Bias?
abstract: arXiv:2610.19945v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Within the most recent two decades, machine translation (MT) has been advanced from a research area to a mature, deployed technology for prose text and most language pairs. However, language has different dimensions of meaning, and the alluded progress has primarily been demonstrated for propositional meaning.   In this small exploratory study, we investigate whether one type of affective meaning, namely different types of linguistically expressed media bias, are retained under automatic translation for two language pairs, English and German as the source languages, and Bulgarian as the target language. We evaluate four state-of-the-art translation methods to answer the question whether and to what degree a loss of non-neutral language (specifically, 27 types of media bias) can occur as a result of applying MT.   Our empirical findings are consistent with the claim that MT does not fully retain existing news bias of its input source text

translated_title: 机器翻译能否保留媒体偏见？
translated_abstract: 在最近二十年中，机器翻译（MT）已经从一个研究领域发展成为一项成熟的、已实际部署应用的散文文本技术，适用于大多数语言对。然而，语言具有不同维度的含义，而上述进展主要体现在命题意义层面上。在这项小型探索性研究中，我们考察了一类情感含义——即以语言形式表达的各类媒体偏见——在自动翻译过程中是否被保留。研究涉及两个语言对：以英语和德语作为源语言，保加利亚语作为目标语言。我们评估了四种最先进的翻译方法，以回答以下问题：应用机器翻译是否会导致非中性语言（具体而言，27种媒体偏见类型）的丢失，以及丢失的程度如何。我们的实证结果与以下论断相符：机器翻译并不能完全保留输入源文本中已有的新闻偏见。
tldr: 本研究考察了机器翻译（英/德语译入保加利亚语）对27类媒体偏见的保留情况，发现翻译过程无法完全保留源文本中的新闻偏见。
en_tdlr: This exploratory study finds that machine translation (English/German to Bulgarian) does not fully retain the 27 types of media bias present in source news texts.
